mission: TOOLBENCH Phase 2: Prove It At Scale

tasks.title: Canonical baseline verification
evidence: npm run check => 0 errors, 0 warnings, 13 hints
npx vitest run => 164 files and 1167 tests passed

tasks.title: Generic zero-network harness for every registered tool and file input
tasks.notes: The test iterates every entry with network:none, performs file input via setInputFiles, awaits result/error, derives same-origin from baseURL, and captures requestfailed/WebSocket traffic.

tasks.title: Golden outputs using trusted external reference tools
tasks.open: ffprobe, unzip, qpdf, and pdfinfo coverage now verifies audio, archive, and PDF metadata outputs; ImageMagick golden assertions and broader media coverage remain open.

tasks.title: Malformed, oversized, cancellation, memory and cleanup coverage
tasks.open: Shared worker aborts, stale UI runs, missing size/count caps, unreleased object URLs, and unsafe ZIP names require tests and fixes.

tasks.title: Chromium Firefox WebKit and mobile matrix
tasks.open: Configuration has Chromium and mobile Safari only; CI installs Chromium only.

tasks.title: Axe and keyboard coverage across all generated routes
tasks.open: Axe covers 6 core routes and 2 tools; 80 tool pages and 9 category pages lack axe, plus keyboard flows.

tasks.title: Bundle budgets and Lighthouse
tasks.open: No bundle budget or Lighthouse CI; current dist/_astro is about 1.4 MB raw.

tasks.title: SEO assertions and list-page structured data
tasks.open: List/category pages have no JSON-LD and no automated canonical/OG/sitemap/robots assertions.

tasks.title: Independent red-team findings and fixes
tasks.open: Zip path traversal/duplicate names, image metadata parsing, calculator evaluation, SVG external resources, and XSS surfaces need failing tests first.

tasks.title: Video feasibility spike
tasks.reason: E4 media tools are now merged, but no evidence-based WebCodecs/demuxer/license/hosting spike has been run.

tasks.title: PWA offline implementation and proof
tasks.open: Service worker exists but offline E2E and zero-network integration are not proven.

tasks.title: CI matrix, audit, license and budget gates
tasks.open: Current CI lacks browser matrix, Lighthouse, bundle-size and generated license audit gates.

tasks.title: Adding-a-tool documentation test
tasks.open: No independent agent has followed the guide and added a trivial tool.
